question: emergency-lighting-exit-signage
unit: NZD per fitting (ea), GST exclusive, 40 fittings, Auckland

band.centre: Auckland; $316.27-$391.35 per fitting; midpoint approx. $354/ea = $14,150 for 40
band.basis: Sum of distinct components, no double-counting: QV luminaire rates are placed as supply-and-install, so no installation labour is added on top; QV cable row is an installed-in-void rate and the QV access row is a dry-hire day rate. Low case = 3W recessed downlight t20:r6 + 2.3W exit sign t20:r11 + 6 hr test/documentation. High case = 3W recessed w/ mounting kit t20:r7 + 5W exit sign t20:r12 + 9 hr test/documentation. Cable held at the scope's fixed 12 m/fitting. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent, BWOF/IQP fees, the initial IQP inspection and Compliance Schedule entry, ongoing re-testing, central battery/inverter/addressable self-test systems, new DB or sub-main, ceiling grid alteration or redecoration, and fire alarm interface/exit door hardware/illuminated signage. All QV rows are UNREVIEWED. Confidence medium - fittings, cable, MCB and access are directly cited; the open items are the supply-vs-install reading of QV luminaire rows, the exit-sign variant, and the tested hours.

band.unit: NZD per fitting (ea), GST exclusive, 40 fittings, Auckland
band.basis: Sum of the components above (no aggregate row added on top of its parts). Low and high both use AKL QV rates. Low = 3W recessed downlight row (t20:r6) with 2.3W exit sign row (t20:r11), 6 electrician hours for test/documentation, 3 days scissor hire, nil test-switch allowance. High = downlight with mounting kit (t20:r7) and 5W exit sign (t20:r12), 12 electrician hours, one week mobile scaffold, full test-switch allowance. Allowances carry about 7% of the high total, so the band rests on cited rates; confidence held at medium because the QV emergency-lighting rows are unreviewed as to scope and inclusions. If those rows are supply-only rather than supply-and-install, add 0.8–1.2 hr/fitting of electrician time and the band becomes roughly $380–$520 per fitting. Total for 40 fittings: $12,521 low, $16,740 high, midpoint $14,631 ($366/fitting). Sense-check: $18.3/m2 of floor area against QV's Electrical Services benchmark for Offices, Basic 1–3 storey, AKL 169/m2.

band.unit: ea (per emergency fitting, averaged over the 28 downlights and 12 exit signs)
band.basis: Bottom-up from QV CostBuilder Auckland rates (GST exclusive, cost rates before margin): QV LED Emergency Lighting installed rates for the 28 downlights and 12 exit signs (ac5fef0...t20:r6/r7/r11/r12), QV installed 1.5mm2 two core + earth TPS for the fixed 480 m of sub-circuit (t7:r71), QV 16A single pole MCBs (t29:r33), QV indoor scissor platform hire (t8:r2) and QV electrician hours for the witnessed 90-minute discharge test, 2293.2 log book, fitting schedule and as-built mark-up (t0:r10); plus two small allowances (test switch/loop terminations at each fitting, board terminations) and one web-sourced certificate fee. 40 fittings: $13,257 (low) to $17,452 (high), mid about $15,350 / $384 per fitting. Fitting supply-and-fix alone is about two thirds of the band and rests on QV rows whose inclusions are not stated - assumed supply-and-fix because QV prices the wiring point separately (t10:r2, AKL 129); if they are supply-only, add roughly 1.2-1.6 electrician hours per fitting and the band becomes roughly $430-$570/ea. Allowances carry about 7% of the low total and 12% of the high total, well inside the one-third limit, so the band is established. Low end assumes clear ceiling void, straight cable pulls and a single continuous install visit; high end assumes congested void, split visits and a more expensive blade-style exit sign. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent and BWOF/IQP fees, the initial IQP/BWOF inspection, ongoing re-testing, central battery/inverter/addressable monitoring, new board or sub-main, ceiling grid alteration or patching, and fire alarm interface - all per the fixed scope. Cross-check only (not added): an Auckland electrical contractor advertises 'Emergency lighting installation and 6-monthly testing in Auckland costs $80 to $250 per fitting installed' (source-1), being fitting plus install before circuit cabling, board work, access, documentation and certificates.

band.unit: each (per emergency fitting, averaged over 28 downlights and 12 exit signs; 40 fittings)
band.basis: Sum of the nine components above (no component counted twice). AUD/NZD: all figures GST exclusive NZD, Auckland column of QV CostBuilder (AKL is the highest of the three centres for the cable, MCB, labour and emergency-lighting rows used). 40-off totals: LOW $12,476 / MID $15,130 / HIGH $17,784. Low = clear ceiling void, single continuous visit, 10m average cable pull, small 208-dollar exit sign row; high = congested void, 14m effective runs, the 5W/two-sided exit-sign row, more access days and the top of the allowance ranges. QV rows are UNREVIEWED. Main drivers (fittings 208-269/fitting, cable 66-92/fitting) sit on cited QV rows; the three allowances (test switch/sundries, testing & log book, DB terminations) total only $25-57/fitting, about 8-13% of the band, so the band is driven by sourced rates, not by judgement. Certification is the weakest link: a single trade-website figure.

band.unit: ea (per emergency fitting, averaged across the mixed luminaire/exit-sign count; 40 fittings total)
band.basis: Working estimate, not a certified price. Sum of the seven components above: low 320.96/ea and high 413.61/ea, i.e. approx. $12,840 - $16,540 for the nominal 40 fittings (midpoint approx. $367/ea, $14,700). All main cost drivers are cited QV CostBuilder Auckland rows: emergency luminaires and exit signs (Electrical Services / LED Emergency Lighting), 1.5mm2 TPS (Electrical Services / Cable: Copper), MCBs (Electrical Services / Control Equipment), hire plant (Preliminaries / Elevated Platform Equipment Hire and Plant Hire Rates) and trade labour (Labour Rates). All QV rows are UNREVIEWED - caveats are stated per component. Allowances are sundries only (approx. 4% of the total, well under a third). Band spread is driven by: exit-sign proxy choice (2.3W vs 5W row, the largest single swing), downlight row choice (with/without mounting kit), access duration, and discharge-test/commissioning hours. GST exclusive; excludes preliminaries, margin, design, consent and BWOF/IQP fees, the initial IQP/BWOF inspection and Compliance Schedule entry, ongoing re-testing, central battery/inverter/addressable or self-test monitoring, new distribution board, sub-main or board upgrade, ceiling grid alteration or redecoration, and fire alarm interface or exit door hardware.
